'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Christopher Bennett DS Set Your Course For Alderaan''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Christopher Bennett]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name '''LEONARD'''. Handwritten. Line 1 Commence Primary Ignition crossed → Set Your Course For Alderaan; line 10 DREADED IMPERIAL STAR → Dreaded Imperial Starfleet (V); line 32 TARKIN DOCTRINE (V) as written (not Tarkin's Orders); line 43 Victory → Victory-Class Star Destroyer (V); line 44 VISAGE → Visage Of The Emperor; line 50 JAN KRINEICH → Janus Greejatus; Operational As Planned (V) at L21–22 and R60.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe]]
* '''Username:''' LEONARD
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
